create_homographic_sampler: create a HomographicSampler to sample multiple homographic crops from batched images
resize_homography_matrix: resize a 3x3 homography matrix when original and warped image sizes change
extract_homographic_crops: extract homographic crops from images using a configured HomographicSampler with specified sampling size
transform_point_coordinates: apply homography transformations to sets of 2D point coordinates with optional image shape normalization
rotate_shift_scale_crops: rotate, shift, and scale virtual crops in a HomographicSampler using normalized coordinates
